name: poe-bd-creator
description: Verification-first Path of Exile 2 build research and generation tooling

interface.shortDescription: Research, create and understand PoE2 builds.
interface.longDescription: Agent-led PoE2 research, build creation and learning with typed MCP verification. Learning delivers a complete H5 reader in the user's language, with exact component icons, category explanations, concept definitions, navigation and search, without storing knowledge.
defaultPrompt: /poe-bd-create 我想要一个适合新手开荒的 Deadeye 弓系 BD
/poe-bd-learn 带我理解这个 BD，生成完整 H5 学习页，讲清技能、装备、天赋和符文的类别与配合，不入库
/poe-bd-learning-loop 使用 10 个同 Family 同等级案例做对照学习
